chunks: Al-Sakuni narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad, from his father عليه السلام, who said:
Ali عليه السلام said: “Whoever makes a bequest without being unfair and without causing harm, it is as though he gave it in charity during his lifetime.”

key_terms.فَلَمْ يَحِفْ: did not act unjustly or unfairly in the bequest
key_terms.وَلَمْ يُضَارَّ: did not cause harm, especially to those affected by the will

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for making a will without injustice or harm?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a bequest made justly and without harming others carries the merit of charity given during one’s lifetime. It emphasizes both the legal and moral importance of fairness in estate distribution and avoiding injury to heirs or other entitled parties.
